from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import pypdfium2 as pdfium
import json,re,hashlib
OUT=Path("reports/research/510300_corporate_loan_weighted_rate_source_qualification_v1")
receipts=json.loads((OUT/"pdf_receipts.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
assert len(receipts)==16 and all(x["valid_pdf_header"] for x in receipts)
TEXT=OUT/"extracted_pages"; RENDER=OUT/"rendered_source_pages"
assert not TEXT.exists() and not RENDER.exists()
TEXT.mkdir(); RENDER.mkdir()
chinese={"1":"一","2":"二","3":"三","4":"四"}
all_candidates=[]; summaries=[]
for row in receipts:
    q=row["quarter"]; path=Path(row["path"])
    assert hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==row["sha256"]
    document=pdfium.PdfDocument(str(path))
    pages=[]; candidates=[]
    for number in range(len(document)):
        page=document.get_page(number)
        textpage=page.get_textpage()
        content=textpage.get_text_range()
        textpage.close()
        compact=re.sub(r"\s+","",content)
        pages.append({"pdf_page_1based":number+1,"text":content})
        for match in re.finditer(r"(?:新发放的企业贷款|新发放企业贷款|企业新发放贷款|企业贷款)[^。；]{0,45}利率",compact):
            a=max(0,match.start()-65); b=min(len(compact),match.end()+150)
            snippet=compact[a:b]
            if "%" not in snippet and "％" not in snippet: continue
            candidates.append({"quarter":q,"pdf_page_1based":number+1,"matched_label":match.group(),
                "paragraph_context":snippet,"source_pdf":row["path"],"source_pdf_sha256":row["sha256"]})
        page.close()
    expected=q[:4]+"年第"+chinese[q[-1]]+"季度"
    cover=re.sub(r"\s+","",pages[0]["text"])
    cover_match=expected in cover
    metadata=document.get_metadata_dict()
    (TEXT/(q+"_pages.json")).write_text(json.dumps(pages,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
    (TEXT/(q+"_全文.txt")).write_text("\n\n".join(f"PDF第{x['pdf_page_1based']}页\n{x['text']}" for x in pages),encoding="utf-8")
    render_paths=[]
    for number in sorted({x["pdf_page_1based"] for x in candidates}):
        page=document.get_page(number-1)
        bitmap=page.render(scale=1.45)
        image=bitmap.to_pil()
        target=RENDER/(q+"_第"+str(number)+"页.png")
        image.save(target)
        image.close(); bitmap.close(); page.close()
        render_paths.append(str(target).replace("\\","/"))
    document.close()
    summary={"quarter":q,"pdf_page_count":len(pages),"cover_exact_requested_quarter":cover_match,
        "cover_text":cover,"metadata":metadata,"rate_candidate_count":len(candidates),
        "rate_candidate_pages":sorted({x["pdf_page_1based"] for x in candidates}),
        "rendered_candidate_pages":render_paths}
    summaries.append(summary); all_candidates.extend(candidates)
    print("全文及原页渲染：",q,"封面匹配",cover_match,"候选",len(candidates),"页",summary["rate_candidate_pages"],flush=True)
(OUT/"全部16原报告全文与封面核对.json").write_text(json.dumps(summaries,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
(OUT/"全部企业贷款利率原文候选.json").write_text(json.dumps(all_candidates,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
print("企业贷款利率原文候选已保存；尚未自动准入任何统计值或模型。",flush=True)
